value.title: Lookup key/value content, not counts alone, governs cache replacement
value.statement: Within NGWLookupTable.sync, compare the initialized cache against the remote string map accepted by the current parser, even when counts match. A missing local key differs from the known nonnull remote Hashtable value. Keep the same cache map object; unchanged/reordered equal content causes no write. SYNC_NONE returns before the read. Handled IOException, NGException or JSONException preserve prior cache; the technical partial-fill regression explicitly throws IOException. A syntactically valid incomplete or silent partial snapshot is not independently detected or proved complete: AUDIT-TODO-NGW-PARTIAL-SNAPSHOT remains UNKNOWN. Existing clear/putAll order and map ownership remain. At both save sites, false adds one numIoExceptions to the existing result; new memory, one attempt, thrown exceptions and equal-next no-write behavior stay unchanged. This is current-pass error signalling, not rollback or retry repair. This does not establish disk durability, retry, prefetch availability, account deletion or remote success; persistence policy remains AUDIT-TODO-NGW-LOOKUP-CACHE-PERSISTENCE.
